questions.question: What is the origin of Hsinchu Pork Ball (新竹贡丸)?

choices.text: Created by a son for his blind mother
choices.explanation: Hsinchu Pork Ball (新竹贡丸) is a meat ball made by beating pork into a paste and shaping it into balls. It is said to have been created during the Ming dynasty by a devoted son for his blind mother, to help her eat pork more easily. It originated in Fujian (part of the Minnan region) and was brought to Taiwan during the Qing dynasty. Hsinchu is the most famous producer of pork balls in Taiwan.
